Perfect Poke
Jul 2026 • Couples
Poke at its finest.. when your done or need a break from the local foods and a burger just isn't cutting it.... Rainbow Poke will hit the spot, super fresh custom flavors all packed into a bowl. It's fresh and flavorful, dynamic and fun...
The building itself has personality and the staff are 99% of that energy, it's quirky and eclectic.
The arrangement has a great flow, the stall will bring you to your table and hand you a menu.. from there you can scan the QR code at the table and order through your phone or the staff will come over and take it.. it's super fast. Within minutes our 2 bowels and beverages were on our table.. I believe one of the coolest things about the menu was they offer different size bowls of food, S, M & L, I was able to add and subtract items from the menu items and the food was delivered accordingly, a great spot to escape the heat and have a fresh Poke bowl..
